systems.owner: Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Technology, financed by World Bank-administered trust funds under ICT Sector Support Phase II (2015-2020)
systems.tiers: 26 government locations around Mogadishu; the review says it is unclear whether the government can raise the resources to maintain it

systems.owner: Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Technology, under the same project
systems.tiers: 30 rooms in 'key ministries across all economic zones': Mogadishu, Galmudug, Somaliland, South West, Jubbaland, Puntland and Hirshabelle, against a target of 15; federal ministries and public institutions in the Federal Member States, with no local government named

systems.owner: Federal Government of Somalia, under the same project
systems.tiers: 25 ministries and the Central Bank of Somalia

note: The evaluation describes a backbone among government sites in Mogadishu and communications rooms in federal and state ministries; no district or municipal office is said to be connected, so there is no fact for the local government office.
